THE PROJECT

Overview

For my senior project, I designed and built AI Driving, a hypothetical autonomous-driving brand website. The project connects page structure and visual design with a working HTML and CSS implementation.

01 / DESIGN PROCESS

Begin with structure and navigation

My design-process report describes an initial HTML prototype before CSS styling. I used that stage to work through button placement, images, and navigation, giving the website a structure before developing its visual treatment.

02 / DESIGN PROCESS

Refine the presentation across devices

The report records checks on laptop, desktop, and mobile, followed by refinements to the design. Darker blues and grays reinforce the technology theme, while the Home, About, Services, and Contact pages separate the introduction from supporting information.

03 / DESIGN PROCESS

Explore the complete website

The original four-page website is available here, including its navigation and supporting pages. Open it to explore the full project, or read the original three-page report for the documented design process.

REFLECTION

What this work shows

This project demonstrates taking a website from a structural prototype into an HTML/CSS implementation. It connects visual hierarchy, navigation, and front-end development in a complete deliverable.

Academic concept for a hypothetical brand. Technology and performance statements are concept copy, not validated product claims. The contact form is a demonstration and does not send messages. Sources: AI driving website folder and design process.pdf.
